lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the branchial slits; spots exhibit a staggered arrangement with increasing spatial interval along the posterior-horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary lateral spots, creating a column-like organization of the larger posterior blobs relative to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-frequency transition from high-intensity reflectance on the ridge peaks to deep shadow in the ventral furrows.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow-colored teleost near the ventral-anterior region and a school of remoras clustered beneath the pectoral fin.
